bsi.editorial_reason: Restore the independently attested complete biblical geographical/sanctuary phrase without merging lexically or geographically distinct places.
editorial_evidence: Exact pinned Macula WLC@47db250bd55d0d8577f2a94fba114ef16c35b23c / SBLGNT@8423afe47b9e8f24b7772e808af45c7159a6fe7e, complete verse inspection in source-audit PR #136
1 Kings 8:10 explicitly refers to the temple holy place (קֹדֶשׁ); 1 Kings 6:5 separately uses the inner sanctuary (דְּבִיר), not a lexical synonym.
